ITEM TEXT
Microloans
are
a
type
of
small
loan
designed
to
support
individuals
or
small
businesses
that
may
not
qualify
for
traditional
bank
loans
.
These
loans
are
often
part
of
microfinance
programs
that
aim
to
promote
financial
inclusion
and
economic
development
.
Microloans
can
be
used
for
a
variety
of
purposes
,
such
as
starting
a
new
business
,
purchasing
equipment
,
or
covering
short-term
operating
costs
.
One
of
the
key
advantages
of
microloans
is
that
they
are
generally
easier
to
obtain
than
larger
loans
from
banks
,
especially
for
borrowers
with
limited
credit
history
or
collateral
.
However
,
the
loan
amount
is
relatively
small
,
typically
ranging
from
a
few
hundred
to
a
few
thousand
dollars
.
Despite
their
size
,
microloans
can
make
a
significant
impact
by
helping
small
businesses
grow
and
become
self-sustaining
.
When
considering
whether
microloans
are
suitable
for
you
,
it's
important
to
assess
your
funding
needs
,
repayment
ability
,
and
how
the
loan
will
support
your
business
goals
.
Overall
,
microloans
are
a
valuable
financial
product
for
entrepreneurs
seeking
modest
but
meaningful
funding
.
